summary: P2 refactor + a11y + backup 30-day nudge + WebDAV + Google Drive UI batch validated end-to-end on preview URL. All 20 launcher tiles + Directory (21 total) open their expected modals after the /notes/ → /notes/rg/ file-move refactor with zero regressions and zero console errors. Backup nudge behavior fully correct: fresh session shows '!' badge, disappears after backup-export-btn triggers a download AND writes rg_last_backup_at, and re-appears as '40d' when localStorage is set 40 days in the past. WebDAV panel/form/fields all render; webdav-push-btn correctly transitions disabled→enabled once webdav-url is filled. Google Drive panel/form/fields all render with the multi-color Google Drive SVG logo (4 <path> elements) and Settings2 icon on the config button. Glass theme toggle switches body[data-rg-glass] between 'true' and 'false' and persists via localStorage rg_glass_theme ('1'/'0'). Pre-visit briefing modal opens correctly from directory-brief-<id>. StarRow buttons expose aria-label='Rate 3 of 5 for Food' and aria-pressed. Recipe icon-only buttons expose aria-label 'Edit recipe' / 'Delete recipe' / 'Log cook recipe'. launcher-directory has 'focus-visible:ring-2' class. Zero React unique-key warnings, zero console errors across every flow.

critical_code_review_comments: RestaurantWorkspacesP5.jsx — the Google Identity Services script is injected via `document.body.appendChild(s)` on every open+client-id combo but there is no cleanup on modal close or client-id change. If a user pastes multiple client IDs consecutively, previous <script> tags remain in DOM (they are guarded by the `document.querySelector('script[src*="accounts.google.com/gsi/client"]')` check so no dupes, but the loaded token client still references the FIRST client id). Suggest storing the token client in a ref and re-initializing on client-id change, or documenting that a page reload is required after changing the client ID.

RestaurantWorkspacesP5.jsx L358 — onChange of gdrive-client-id writes to localStorage on EVERY keystroke. Fine for correctness but noisy for QuotaExceededError on some browsers. Consider debouncing or writing on blur.

RestaurantWorkspacesP5.jsx WebDAV push/pull do not validate the URL is https://. A malformed value is fine (fetch will fail) but throwing a friendlier 'Enter a URL starting with https://' before the network call would improve UX.

RestaurantsGaloreDashboardModal.jsx L189-213 — the custom launcher-backup button inlines its own styling instead of reusing the shared `launcher()` helper. This is fine but means any future style tweak to launchers must be applied in TWO places. Consider extending `launcher()` to accept a `badge` prop and using it uniformly.

glass-theme.css still targets `[role="dialog"][data-state="open"]` globally when data-rg-glass='true' on body — same concern flagged in iter_32. Non-RG Radix dialogs (e.g. note editor, settings) will also receive the frosted-glass treatment. Scope with a container class if unintended.

The `daysSinceLastBackup()` export is imported in RestaurantsGaloreDashboardModal.jsx from './rg/RestaurantWorkspacesP5' — after the refactor this path is correct, but note this creates a top-of-tree circular potential if RestaurantWorkspacesP5.jsx ever imports the dashboard. Currently safe.

GIS script actually loads successfully in the preview environment (outbound https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client is reachable), so gdrive-push-btn WILL become enabled once a client ID is typed — this is correct, not a bug. Backup nudge testids: launcher-backup-nudge (text '!' when never backed up, '<N>d' when >30d stale). Backup-export-btn triggers a real .json download — use page.expect_download() to capture.
